modelContextEvidence.sourceMechanism: RecordingRun.observeClaude records Claude stream user/tool_result blocks only when correlated to a preceding assistant/tool_use ID. Full guide text is retained in the source artifact. Private reasoning is excluded.
modelContextEvidence.interpretation: The model emitted some dependent preparation calls in the same response before receiving the guide result. This is not evidence of a separate post-guide decision for every tool. The full guide and MCP schema tool results were available before the subsequent generate_proof call. Internal attention or reasoning is not observable.
modelContextEvidence.recordingLimit: Tool-use IDs were checked by the stream decoder but not retained in the published terminal records; this audit does not reconstruct or invent them.

permissionEvidence.recordedStakeApprovalBinding: Delegate, amount, Arc chain, gate, verifier and verified proof fingerprint; the fingerprint identifies the proof binding the original delegation. The follow-up hardening also includes the full original action in the second approval and compares immutable receipts before execution.

capabilityBoundary: Claude chooses calls from ten local allowlisted MCP tools. The application constrains the circuit, scope, payment route, amount and transaction contract. Public remote documentation is tool data; it cannot install or execute arbitrary code. Request-permission tools wait for the browser decision and cannot approve themselves.

video.interaction: Actual CUA user input and two explicit UI approval actions; agent tools wait for each decision
